title: The Keys of World Empire
narration_slice: Did masked strangers from the Shadow truly place the keys of world empire into shepherd hands? At the Citadel of Oldtown, maesters view that eastern claim with pointed skepticism. If an older civilization in the Shadow commanded dragons first, Maester Yandel asks, why did they
locations: the early Freehold and the western coast (0481-0484); the Citadel of Oldtown at night (0485-0490)
creature_refs: no dragon in this batch - the beast imagined here is marble, at the Citadel gate
the_scepticism_rule: The Citadel's disbelief must be carried by hands, chain, marble and light - never by a face. The standing ban on showing maesters as characters holds: 0485 crops above the wrists, 0486 renders the maesters strictly from behind, and 0487's only face is carved stone. This is the third appearance of the Citadel in the episode and the rule has not bent once.
fused_stone_rule: Dragonflame-fused black stone is the visual signature of Valyrian power and it must look POURED: seamless, glassy, continuous, cooled from molten flow, slightly translucent at thin edges. It must never read as coursed masonry with joints, which is the failure that caught 0453 and again caught 0482. Negate ashlar, coursed masonry, stacked blocks, joints, mortar, rubble and brick by name.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 28mm from road level looking steeply up: two colossal **seamless, mortarless, dragonflame-fused** black stone piers lean toward each other and converge at the top of frame, their surfaces glassy, continuous, jointless, with no capital, no base and no ornament of any kind - each one a single cooled mass. Between them a narrow fused basalt road runs straight away toward a thin dark smoke plume. Two robed figures walk away up the road, small. Flat cold overcast so the black swallows light instead of shining. **The first architecture this episode allows Valyria to have**, and it looks grown rather than built. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.shot_type: 40mm over-the-shoulder: a shepherd at the edge of the fused basalt road
scenes.qc_note: 40mm over-the-shoulder from behind a shepherd's shoulder - coarse undyed wool, loose silver-white hair over the collar, one dirty hand hanging down, **no face at all**. Beyond him in sharp focus the fused basalt road runs away between two colossal **monolithic fused black stone piers**, each one a single continuous cooled mass, glassy, jointless, base to out-of-frame top, with **no joint line, no seam, no block edge and no mortar anywhere on them** - poured, like thick obsidian, faintly translucent where the light grazes the edge. A low rise of the same cooled stone closes the road and one thin dark plume crosses the pale sky. Flat cold overcast. **The masonry failure is fixed on the second pass, and the fix was the negation list.**

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 28mm wide across a bare ash valley: three seamless fused black stone shapes - a leaning pier, a low fused platform, a curved spine like the cooled edge of a flow - all jointless and glassy, sitting in the ash as if they had cooled there. No roofs, no windows, no ornament. Sheep graze around them. Two herdsmen stand at the near edge with their backs to us, hoods down. Three smoking cones behind in the haze. Quiet, wide and slightly strange: **architecture arriving in a herding country.** Reframed 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 24mm ultra-wide from a coastal ridge: long folds of ash-grey and emerald falling to a hard cold turquoise coastline, black rock shelves running into white surf, dark cypress and wild olive, and **Oldtown a pale smudge on the far coast hundreds of leagues away** - readable only as a shape, and the frame does not invite you to look closer. Three of the Fourteen Flames behind, smoke bent west toward the sea. Two tiny figures on the ridge with their backs to us, facing the water. The episode's best composition: the whole distance between a shepherd and an institution in one frame. Reframed 12-728.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 50mm at desk height in warm candlelight - the one warm light this episode allows - on a maester's hands and **nothing above the wrists**. Old, ink-stained fingers, knuckles raised, one finger following a line on a page that is turned away and out of focus, so the text reads only as a blurred block of faint marks and **not one word is legible** (verified at 2.4x). A forged chain of dull iron, copper, bronze and pale silver lies across the wrist, worn bright at the high points. No head, no hood, no eyes, by rule. The Citadel's scepticism carried by hands and metal. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 35mm lateral tracking through the scriptorium at night: long slanted desks, tall windows showing only black, open books and scrolls that read as **shapes of pale paper and dark leather with no legible line anywhere** - pages edge-on, turned away or closed. Two maesters in dove-grey cross the room briskly, seen strictly from behind, **no face visible at all**; their chains catch candlelight at the shoulder. Dust and candle smoke in the air, small separate pools of warm light, the far end of the room in darkness. Purposeful and anonymous. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 65mm long lens at dusk in falling rain, on the head of one of the **twin dark green marble winged sphinxes** at the Citadel gate. Weathered green marble with paler veins, chipped at the brow, lichen in the seams, a carved sightless face running with water; the great folded wing rises behind, feathers in shallow relief, marble slick and beaded. A low warm lantern spill from the gate arch behind half-lights the cheek. **The only face in the frame is stone**, and no living person appears. Accepted with a note: the silhouette reads a little closer to a classical angel than to a beast-bodied sphinx; the clawed forelimb at the lower edge carries the animal half, and the AFFC reference frame IMG0035 remains the canonical version of the creature. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 50mm in a dark torch-lit vault, and **the subject is a bare plinth with nothing on it**. Pale limestone, waist-high, scuffed on top, with the four shallow dark depressions where a statue's feet would have been bolted - empty bolt holes, slightly rusted. No statue and none for a very long time. Vault ribs above, black shelves behind, one narrow window high left showing only black. Two guttering candles in an iron stand throw a small warm pool that dies within three paces. **The argument made literally: nothing was left behind to look at.** The shelf load faintly suggests many books; at magnification only marks and shadows.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 35mm across the Honeywine at dusk in steady rain: the Citadel rises behind a curtain of wet air, **weathered, squat, administrative** - narrow windows, no ornament, no banners, no gilding - with a few warm lantern points behind shutters and its mass dissolving upward into low cloud. A stone bridge crosses on the left. Rain streaks the whole frame. **No figure is resolvable anywhere**: the two or three dark smudges on the bridge parapet stay paper-cut silhouettes at 5x, which is exactly the intent - people exist here but none of them is a character.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — Maester Yandel's skepticism vs vanishing Shadow teachers
scenes.qc_note: 24mm from the Citadel's tallest tower at night: the city below as a dark field of tiled roofs and chimneys punctuated by **hundreds of small warm lamps** - an ordinary evening, not a festival - the Honeywine cutting through as a black band with a few moored boats, and beyond the last roofs the Whispering Sound running flat and black to a thin pale line of water at the horizon. No moon, no stars, overcast. The Citadel's own towers stand out of the near rooftops at left. **A small warm civilisation at the edge of a very large dark** - which is the sceptic's whole case, seen from his own window.

closed_note: Closed 10/10. The Citadel material is now complete and the ban never bent: a bare plinth with empty bolt holes (0488), the institution as a squat weathered mass in rain (0489), the city as one small warm light in a large dark (0490). 0482 fixed the masonry failure on the second pass with the negation list.
